incidents.finding: LinkedIn removed the HeyReach company page and some executive profiles. HeyReach stated customer automations and the product continued operating. Recorded as a historical non-China platform ToS action, not a qualifying unresolved API security incident.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified. CheckApiKey is documented with an empty success body, so healthcheck uses POST /campaign/GetAll with offset=0,limit=1 instead.

research.searchCoverage: Official HeyReach Public API documents HTTPS host https://api.heyreach.io/api/public, X-API-KEY header, GET /auth/CheckApiKey, POST /campaign/GetAll (offset/limit, max 100), GET /campaign/GetById?campaignId=, POST /list/GetAll, and POST /li_account/GetAll. Operator is HeyReach Inc OÜ (Estonia) providing a global LinkedIn outreach API. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found the March 2026 LinkedIn company-page removal, which is not a customer-data or API credential compromise.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
